scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && bun scripts/prerender.ts
scripts.deploy: bun run typecheck && bun run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply mayarin-landing-early-access --remote && wrangler pages deploy --branch main
scripts.early-access:list: wrangler d1 execute mayarin-landing-early-access --remote --command "select email, datetime(created_at, 'unixepoch') as submitted_at from early_access_signups order by created_at desc"
